name: Abe no Yasuaki
source:
[spoiler]Actually only 4 years old.[/spoiler]

One of the Hachiyou, he is the Genbu of Earth. Yasuaki is an Onmyouji, and a disciple to the famous, historical Onmyouji Abe no Seimei. He is cold and analytical. [spoiler]Because he is an artificial human created by Abe no Seimei, Yasuaki lacks human emotions.[/spoiler] His elemental attribute is Mountain, and his dragon jewel is located beneath his right eye.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de]Wikipedia[/url]]
